guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 在 Yakkamon 注册
guide.description: 使用 Yakkamon 预注册页面上的邮箱地址创建你的账户。此阶段不需要钱包。注册时输入推荐码 YAKKA-52UCFU。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.

guide.title: 每天培育你的卵子
guide.description: 每天点击鸡蛋 3 次即可获得 +6 分。每日连胜会增加奖金，错过一天会重置连胜。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.

guide.title: 连接 Discord 和 X
guide.description: 将你的 Discord 和 X 账户关联起来，各获得 +10 分。 Discord 中的有用帖子可通过社区反应赚取额外积分，一旦连接 X，每周分享任务每周可支付 +20 积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.

guide.title: 链接并验证钱包
guide.description: 连接钱包并签署一条消息以证明所有权，即可获得 +10 积分。免费铸造白名单还需要经过验证的钱包，因此请在 2026 年 10 月 1 日之前完成此操作。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.

guide.title: 推荐朋友
guide.description: 每个加入的经过验证的朋友都会为你赢得 +30 积分。你的前五次推荐立即生效；之后，受邀者必须验证 Discord 和 X 并达到 100 分才能获得奖金。多重会计在审核时被过滤掉。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.

guide.title: 10 月 1 日铸造免费 Monster NFT
guide.description: 使用经过验证的钱包加入 Ronin 上免费铸造 10,000 个 Monster NFT。除了少量的汽油费外，它不需要花费任何费用，每个训练师仅限一枚铸造，铸造会增加你的排行榜总积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
guide.original_description: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.

guide.title: 铸造你的 Yakkamon NFT
guide.description: 在白名单检查器上检查你的 Ronin 钱包符合哪个 Wave 资格如果你在第 2 波或第 4 波中铸造，则存入 5 $FLOWER（请参阅 $FLOWER 存款指南）当你的 Wave 打开并铸造时，将你的 Ronin 钱包连接到 Ronin Launchpad，保留一些 RON 作为 Gas
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas

sourcedSteps.title: Sign Up at Yakkamon
sourcedSteps.body: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.

sourcedSteps.title: Nurture Your Egg Daily
sourcedSteps.body: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect Discord and X
sourcedSteps.body: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.

sourcedSteps.title: Link and Verify a Wallet
sourcedSteps.body: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.

sourcedSteps.title: Refer Friends
sourcedSteps.body: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.

sourcedSteps.title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
sourcedSteps.body: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.

sourcedSteps.title: Mint Your Yakkamon NFT
sourcedSteps.body: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas
